video_title: Perk thinks Jaylen Brown makes the Philadelphia 76ers EASTERN FAVORITES 📈 | NBA Today

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins praises the Oklahoma City Thunder's free agency moves
quotes.excerpt: I think they've had a great off season.
quotes.quote: They got Isaiah Hartenstein on a new three-year deal and he took a mild pay cut. All these centers are getting paid a bunch of money. He took a slight pay cut. Also, I love the addition of Daimar. I'm giving them a B-plus. I'd give them an A-minus, but because they had to lose some players and they traded up for Bennett, I think they've had a great off season.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins evaluates the San Antonio Spurs' free agency additions
quotes.excerpt: The core is intact and don't forget about that guy, Dylan Harper.
quotes.quote: I'm going to give them a B-plus just based on what they've been able to do. They retained the core of their group. This is the starting five that ended game five against New York here. But the move I like the most is Tobias Harris. The one thing that Victor Wembanyama needed at the end of these games is a stretch big, a veteran that can make shots. The core is intact and don't forget about that guy, Dylan Harper. You are going to see a heavy dose of Dylan Harper next year.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins criticizes the Houston Rockets' offseason strategy
quotes.excerpt: Going out and getting Marcus Smart, that was cute, but that wasn't handsome.
quotes.quote: Going out and getting Marcus Smart, that was cute, but that wasn't handsome. Making Sengun untouchable at the trade deadline when you probably could have pursued Giannis Antetokounmpo pissed me off. Fred VanVleet, that's fine, you need a floor general, but that's not moving the needle. I have to grade them and give them a C. They are just not doing enough. By the way, what's going to happen with Tari Eason? He turned down 100 plus million dollars last season. Are you going to pay him? That's the most important position in the league to win a championship.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins explains why the 76ers are Eastern Conference favorites
quotes.excerpt: They should be favorites to win the Eastern Conference.
quotes.quote: They should be favorites to win the Eastern Conference. We talk about making powerful moves, that team is doing their damn thing. They have two reasons why. When you talk about perimeter play, Tyrese Maxey and Jaylen Brown rank number one and number five in the league in drives and made field goals. We know how explosive Tyrese Maxey is in getting to the basket. You sprinkle in some V.J. Edgecombe in there, tell me how you are going to game plan for that.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst discusses Joel Embiid's health and impact on Philadelphia
quotes.excerpt: If he's healthy, it brings in the type of dominant force that you can totally build around.
quotes.quote: The issue with Philly, whenever you're assessing them, whether they've got Jaylen Brown or not, is Joel Embiid. If he's healthy, it brings in the type of dominant force that you can totally build around in a playoff setting. But again, it's very hard to count on him. The one thing that they did yesterday that I liked was they signed a couple of big guys. They signed Dean Wade, who's 6'10, and they signed Ariel Hukporti, who is a backup. What you need in this NBA right now is you've got to have size.

quotes.speaker: Brian Windhorst
quotes.summary_phrase: Brian Windhorst analyzes the Eastern Conference landscape and the Pacers
quotes.excerpt: I put them in the conversation in the top six.
quotes.quote: I put them in the conversation in the top six. I think there are still moves they need to get some front court depth. There's no backup big to Joel Embiid. But we talk about all these teams making moves, but we don't talk about the Pacers. They get Hali and Zubac back. They made, they took up sixer yesterday. They got Hali Ubre, a nice signing for them.

quotes.speaker: Kendrick Perkins
quotes.summary_phrase: Kendrick Perkins evaluates the 76ers' roster depth and front office
quotes.excerpt: Bob Myers, one of the best to ever do it, has an eye for what a championship team look like.
quotes.quote: Bob Myers, one of the best to ever do it, has an eye for what a championship team look like. I love the signing today of Anfernee Simons, give you more depth off the bench and more scoring. Going to replace Quentin Grimes as far as a guy to be able to come in and stretch the floor. Offensively, they are going to be a juggernaut. If Joel Embiid can give you 16 and 10 a night, that's going to be good enough to get them where they want to go. Think about what we saw from Karl-Anthony Towns this year. He fell in line right behind OG Anunoby. It was Jaylen Brunson, OG Anunoby, then Karl-Anthony Towns.
